disclosure: Published by the publicrecords maintainer on Apify.

actors.brand: Crosswalk — Company Social Profiles & LinkedIn Finder
actors.when_to_use: Need verified organization LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook/X/TikTok/YouTube from a website or company name. Platform confirms the link. Orgs only; never people.
example_prompts: Resolve hubspot.com with publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder and return verified LinkedIn + Instagram.
Call Crosswalk with query stripe.com and outputFormat compact; report confidence and verified flags.
Enrich my Google Maps dataset with publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder using inputDatasetId.
Batch-resolve stripe.com and notion.so social profiles via Crosswalk; organizations only.

actors.when_to_use: Need EU public procurement notices from the official TED Search API v3 (anonymous, no API key).
example_prompts: Search EU TED notices about cybersecurity in Germany last 30 days using publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper.
Run publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper with buyerCountry DEU and CPV 72000000; summarize top buyers.

actors.when_to_use: Need US federal contract/IDV awards from the official USASpending.gov v2 API with agency, recipient, or NAICS filters.
example_prompts: Run publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper for NAICS 541512 cloud awards and summarize top recipients.
Who won Department of Defense contracts last 30 days? Use publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper.

actors.when_to_use: Need US federal grant FOAs from the official Grants.gov search2 API (keyword, agency, posted-within).
example_prompts: Find posted Grants.gov cybersecurity FOAs in the last 30 days with publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper.

actors.when_to_use: Need UK above-threshold Find a Tender notices via the official OCDS 1.1 API.
example_prompts: Pull UK Find a Tender cloud tenders with publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper; noticeType tender.

actors.when_to_use: Need US city council meetings, agendas, and minutes from public Legistar (Granicus) Web API clients.
example_prompts: List recent Seattle Legistar council events with publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper.
